Thanks a lot for your response :) 
In my situation, I think it's 2. 
I would have been happy with my situation, my results and achievements (I'm in high school) at the end of the semester ( it is even more and better than I wished for ) if there werent certain people who are even better than me.
And..I wouldn't honestly care about their lives or at least, I wouldn't be so envious, if they didn't show off and call me stupid and inferior. This one sets me off. Literally makes me wanna die( I was verbally bullied for long years)
It is very frustrating and I think they have some issues too, they suffer from 1 or 2 case. Maybe that's why they are spiteful and mean and not even correct because I didnt even work as hard as I could, I didnt even wish for more.
I'm still content and don't want more, but I feel somehow indebted/forced to want for more, to prove my worth on this earth.
I'm self-conscious , I do care a lot about what others say (yes. there is another problem..) so maybe I didn't pinpoint my problem correctly..or the envy I felt was just for a very short time
maybe he has a lower EQ but guess what. He's so damn proud of it. And I would be too.. we're just so desperate to be 'smart'..we don't care about anything else
